title: 无符号模回绕 vs 有符号溢出（UB）与安全检测
expected_output:
=== unsigned wraps mod 2^n (defined) ===
  uint8_t 200 + 100 = 44     (300 mod 256, guaranteed by the standard)
  uint32 4000000000 + 400000000 = 105032704   (mod 2^32, guaranteed)

=== signed overflow is UNDEFINED BEHAVIOUR ===
  int 2000000000 + 2000000000 has no defined result; the compiler may assume it never happens

=== detecting it WITHOUT triggering UB ===
  __builtin_add_overflow(2000000000, 2000000000) -> OVERFLOW DETECTED
  __builtin_mul_overflow(2000000000, 2) -> OVERFLOW DETECTED

=== INT_MIN edge cases ===
  INT_MAX = 2147483647, INT_MIN = -2147483648
  (int)((unsigned)INT_MAX + 1u) = -2147483648   (implementation-defined wrap)
  INT_MIN / -1 is UB on int; as long long it is 2147483648

=== saturating add ===
  sat_add(2000000000, 2000000000)   = 2147483647
  sat_add(-2000000000, -2000000000) = -2147483648
  sat_add(1, 2)                     = 3
